injuries.detail: He has not featured since the Arsenal game because of a heel problem, and he was left out of the Fenerbahce trip. Iraola described it as a day-to-day matter of pain, and the Netherlands have omitted him, so Manchester United is the hoped-for return.
His muscle problem has kept him sidelined for several games, and he is still waiting for medical clearance to resume training. A return before Manchester United is possible but not confirmed.
He is listed among the long-term absentees and is still working through his Achilles rehabilitation during the international break. No firm return date has been set.
He is still recovering from a serious knee injury picked up in January. He may rejoin group training after the international break, pending medical clearance.
He has not played this season while recovering from an ACL injury. He is expected to start training with the group during the international break.

He tweaked the knee again late in the Crystal Palace win and was not fully fit when he came off. Iraola said he will need to be assessed by the medical staff before any national team call-up.
He withdrew from the Netherlands squad with a minor knock and has been dealing with discomfort for weeks. Iraola hopes the break allows him to recover in time for Manchester United.
